text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It's the day of the Japanese Derby. Rice Shower and Mihono Bourbon exchange a firm handshake in the runners' tunnel…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: …And yet again, Matikanetannhauser watches from afar. I ask her why she always hides, to which she replies…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: …And yet again, Matikanetannhauser watches from afar. I ask her why she always hides, to which she replies…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: That's not a moment for an ordinary gal like me to barge in on.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She starts questioning why the director has such high hopes for someone as ordinary as her. With that on her mind…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The race to decide the number one Umamusume of this generation, the Japanese Derby, begins!
